contracts.catalogReadiness: Future execution requires a nonempty approved type roster and an explicit approved profile per type, including an explicit no-event profile if desired. Missing profiles are configuration errors, never silent event skips or permission to execute proposals.
contracts.history: Machine uses canonical family ID machine. Main/Hybrid/host/base/origin identity draws share usedRaceFamilyIds. Commit before type events, exclude it from every later identity draw, and restore committed history on replay without redispatch.
contracts.boundaries: Golem remains separate. Anime MC Sci-fi Cyborg keeps its existing two Tech Weapon spins; Pilot keeps the existing rideable vehicle event. Selecting proposed Machine Cyborg/Mecha does not import those packages. No automatic mapping of archived video Cyborg into Machine.
contracts.size: One global Size stage; Machine body reference/metric and subtype measurements remain pending. Never default to Human or add a second Size spin. Existing Raksasa giant binding still applies when actually selected.
contracts.effects: AI grants Digital Being plus +2 numeric Intelligence once per type source, no additional AI type spin. Cyborg +1 numeric Intelligence once plus exactly one weapon; Android exactly one owned power. Mecha only chosen body-model identity. Transformer selects one vehicle form and receives its linked Vehicle Shifting power, without another power selector. Nanobot directly grants one Shapeshifting power, without subtype/model/acquisition spin. Household now grants one extremely weak mundane-function power linked to its actual item, with no additional acquisition spin.
contracts.mastery: Any later approved powers use the one common Power Mastery, with existing source-scoped exceptions. Weapons retain per-weapon mastery/compatible Master+ Enchant; Machine alone adds no mastery modifier.
contracts.context: Stack only actual family/type/event commits and their provenance. Narration does not generate effects or future stat/type facts.
contracts.influence: Future conditional probability/eligibility profiles remain pending. Type identity alone does not invent multipliers, restrictions or guaranteed stats.
contracts.idempotence: One subtype invocation per actual Machine source component, linked to parent spin/component/root slot and exact continuation. Resume restores actual committed results without new draws or duplicated effects.
